material_changes.baseline: Independent workers implement, but the controller flow and milestone ownership are distributed across prose.
material_changes.candidate: Independent subagents are the only implementation and fix authors; controller substitution and reviewer fixes are explicitly forbidden.

material_changes.baseline: Review appears in stages but does not define four named, uniformly blocking milestones.
material_changes.candidate: Scope, design readiness, every task implementation, and landing readiness have independent blocking gates and explicit return paths.

material_changes.baseline: A 15-minute status rule exists without a complete event-triggered status contract.
material_changes.candidate: Preflight, every stage transition, immediate blockers, and 15-minute heartbeats report against the written plan with fixed fields.

material_changes.baseline: The body permits global discovery and contains a WorkGraph-specific addendum.
material_changes.candidate: The body uses only host subagents and named Core-Prompts companions, with no machine, provider, WorkGraph, or arbitrary external dependency.

material_changes.baseline: Mentor remained a neighboring deployable capability.
material_changes.candidate: Mentor is retired from Core-Prompts delivery so Batman has one explicit controller surface rather than an overlapping oversight deployment.
